Name: Ascent of Adummim
ModernLocation: Unknown; on the Judah-Benjamin border, on the road toward Jericho
Description: A pass on the border between Judah and Benjamin, on the way up from the Jordan valley toward Jerusalem. It is traditionally the Jerusalem-Jericho road, but that identification is a tradition, not a certainty.
BiblicalSignificance: Adummim's ascent is a border pass on the road between Jericho and Jerusalem.
